items.title_zh: 这位历史学家的推特帖子称温斯顿·丘吉尔没有造成饥荒，但遭到了猛烈抨击
items.title_en: This Historian’s Twitter Thread Saying Winston Churchill Didn’t Cause Famine is Getting Flak
items.summary_zh: 安德烈亚斯·库雷亚斯（Andreas Koureas）因称温斯顿·丘吉尔没有助长孟加拉饥荒而在推特上受到严厉批评。
items.summary_en: Andreas Koureas is receiving flak on Twitter for saying that Winston Churchill did not contribute to the Bengal famine.

items.title_zh: 莱昂内尔·梅西 (Lionel Messi) 佩戴着球迷在 FIFA 世界杯上送给他的四岁幸运丝带
items.title_en: Lionel Messi Wears Four-year-old Lucky Ribbon Gifted to Him by Fan in FIFA World Cup
items.summary_zh: 在 2022 年 FIFA 世界杯上，人们看到莱昂内尔·梅西的左脚踝上系着四年前一位阿根廷记者送给他的红丝带，以示好运
items.summary_en: In FIFA World Cup 2022, Lionel Messi was seen wearing the same red ribbon on his left ankle that was given to him by an Argentinian journalist four years back as token of good luck

items.title_zh: “有人能把背景中的那个人去掉吗？”女人要求编辑照片激发了模因
items.title_en: ‘Can Someone Remove That Guy in the Background?’ Woman’s Request To Edit Picture Inspires Memes
items.summary_zh: 一位女士希望从她的照片中剪掉站在背景中的一个男人，并请求互联网用户帮助她进行编辑，这在推特上激发了有趣的表情包。
items.summary_en: A woman wanted a guy standing in the background to be cropped out of her picture and asked internet users to help her with the edit which rather inspired funny memes on Twitter.
